title: Viva-voce/Interview Notification for the post of Foreman, Dept. of Printing
text:
KEY LINES:
University to ascertain Educational Qualification.

FULL TEXT:
ARUNACHAL PRADESH
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
ITANAGAR
No. PSC-R(B)/14/2020 Dated Itanagar, the 13th April, 2022
N O T I F I C A T I O N
In continuation to Commission’s result Notification No. PSC-R(B)/14/2020 Dated
7th April, 2022 it is to inform that Commission has fixed the date for Viva-voce for the post of
Foreman under the Department of Printing on 13th May, 2022 at APPSC Office, Itanagar.
The candidates are directed to upload the self-attested xerox copy of the
following document in pdf format not exceeding 1Mb in size through their respective login ID in
the Commission’s website www.appsc.gov.in on or before 11th May, 2022, 1600 hours from
issue of this notification:
1. Matriculation Certificates (Class X) issued by Board for proof of Date of Birth.
2. Class XII Certificate and Marksheet.
3. Diploma Certificate and Marksheet issued by Assistant
Registrar/Registrar/Controller of Examination/Vice-Chancellor of the concerned
University to ascertain Educational Qualification.
4. APST Certificate for APST Candidates.
5. Intimation letter to HoD for those who are in regular Govt. service/NOC.
Further, the Candidates are directed to download their admit cards w.e.f. 6th
May, 2022 onwards from commissions website www.appsc.gov.in
Memo No: - PSC-R(B)/14/2020: Dated Itanagar, the 13th April, 2022
Copy to: -
1. The Editor, The Arunachal
Times.
2. The Editor, The Eastern Sentinel.
3. The Editor, Echo of Arunachal
4. Notice Board/Commission’s website
5. Office Copy.
} With a request to publish the Notification in one
of your issues of your paper and to submit copies
of bill in triplicate to the undersigned for
payment.
